title: Shaping Austin's Financial Plan Policy
summary:
*   A special work session was held to establish policy direction for the City of Austin's 1987/88 fiscal year financial plan.
*   The meeting's sole purpose was to discuss and shape the city's financial strategy for the upcoming fiscal year.
*   Council members received a comprehensive outline to guide their discussions on the financial plan and policy goals.
transcript:
